trainer/30033.htm.text: Magister Baulro: I am Magister Baulro, in charge all magical instruction here. All beneficial magic has its origin in Einhasad, the goddess of nature and light. Through years of study, we can acquire the skill to tap into this awesome force. Do you wish to learn that skill?

trainer/30033-1.htm.text: Magister Baulo: Johanes, the priest of this place, is my twin brother. When we were young, we were expected to follow in the footsteps of our father, who was bishop. But I became fascinated by the power of magic, and opted to become a magister instead. I will be forever grateful to my brother for e…

trainer/30033-noteach.htm.text: Magister Baulro: Unfortunately, I cannot teach someone in your profession. You must seek instruction elsewhere, my child.

Q00001_LettersOfLove/30033-01.html.text: Magister Baulro: Darin sent you, eh? Well, well... He's a fine lad, but far too shy for his own good. Q00001_LettersOfLove/30033-02.html.text: Magister Baulro: Take this potion to Darin. I'm sure he's waiting anxiously for your return!

Q00006_StepIntoTheFuture/30033-01.html.text: Magister Baulro: You seem anxious, my child. I don't think you're here to learn magic... What's the matter? How can I help?

links.text: "I want to visit Giran in order to increase my knowledge, but I can't afford the journey."

Q00006_StepIntoTheFuture/30033-03.html.text: Magister Baulro: Take the letter of recommendation I gave you to Sir Colin Windawood at the Obelisk of Victory .

Q00006_StepIntoTheFuture/30033-02.html.text: Magister Baulro: Hmmm... I see. It is certainly expensive to travel to the mainland, especially to a place as far away as Giran. common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
